notes: Zone l60_south of the lot60 area: the ground south-west of the A/B border. The JSON was written by /tmp/claude-0/p4/lot60/l60_south/gen.py (scratch, not kept). Since the review of 2026-11-20 this file is edited by hand; it is the source. Frame: model metres, +X east, +Y grid north. Sources: NJ 2020 ortho (0.15 m/px, leaf-off), 2017 LiDAR (0.5 m grid and raw points), OSM for names and as a guide. What is here: one asphalt surface for the bus lot (OSM 840849374..381, unnamed), the drive strip along the divider, the open lot west of Lot 61 (unnamed), the drive west of Lot 61 (OSM 233913138 south part), the aprons and truck parking round MSU Vehicle Maintenance, with the building as a hole; the building (OSM 233913117) in two parts from the LiDAR; 15 curbed islands in the bus lot; the walk along the drive's south side; the south-west half of the bulb at the spine walk's end with its teardrop island. Bus lot layout: a fan of bands of stall dividers about 11 m long (a car stall at each end or one bus), split along the middle by a thin line, with aisles between; the bands curve, so each is drawn as two straight chords. Dividers were found with an oriented line filter on the ortho (white top-hat), joined into lines, and each row's base line fitted by least squares through the divider ends; the pitch by least squares on the divider positions (gaps under cars counted from it). Fits per row are in each marking's 'fit'. A row of square car stalls (21, pitch 2.59 m, depth 4.8 m) runs along the divider's south-west edge: the band there is a parking row and then the drive strip. Lines that looked like stalls along the bus lot's south edge are gaps between tree shadows, not paint: none drawn. The bus lot's south edge: the LiDAR ground stays level about 9 m into the tree belt, then a low berm and the bank down to the pond (98.6 m); the paving is ended 0.5 m inside the berm (UNVERIFIED). Borders: asphalt runs 0.2 m under the divider, the Lot 60 south-east walk and the spine walk (concrete wins), 0.2 m past the open cut at the junction ((-123, 1389.8) to (-131, 1378)) and at the west drive ((-266.95, 1439.91) to where the bus lot's north-east curb crosses the border at (-273.6, 1446.3)); to the footprint on the Village side (overlapping Lot 61's asphalt). No paint within 0.5 m of a border; no curb within 1 m of the Village line. Not drawn: lamps (no pole returns in the 2017 LiDAR in this zone, and no pole shadow could be told from tree shadows); aisle arrows (small white marks in the aisles, shapes not readable at 0.15 m/px); the pavement word at (-220, 1383) (not readable); the concrete pad with a 2.5 m structure at the building's east corner (not identified); garage doors (the format has none). Trees come from tools/evidence/trees.py.
